current_state.zh: A blog post documents a working Nintendo Switch 2 jailbreak (ns2jb) achieved by pairing an experienced security researcher with LLM-driven automation over a KVM and USB/Bluetooth controls, reportedly yielding decrypted read/write filesystem access and opening the door to game dumps and homebrew.
